p: with words: To have comfort from them.
loveth his own soul: He that is upright in judgment finds favour from God.
Delight is not proper for a: The free use of things are not to be permitted to him who cannot use them correctly.
to pass over a transgression: That is, to cover it by charity, and to do in it as may most serve to God's glory.
dropping: As rain that drops and rots the house.
deliver him: Though for a time he gives place to counsel, yet soon after will he give place to his raging affections.
man's heart: Man's device will not have success, unless God governs it, whose purpose is unchangeable.
kindness: That is, that he be honest: for the poor man who is honest is to be esteemed above the rich who is not virtuous.
simple will beware: That is, the simple and ignorant men learn when they see the wicked punished.
devoureth iniquity: Takes a pleasure and delight in it, as gluttons and drunkards in delicate meats and drinks.
